summary.text: Mario R. Mattera is a Republican member of the New York State Senate who has represented District 2 since January 2021 and is running for re-election on the Republican and Conservative lines.

paragraphs.text: Mario Mattera lives in St. James, New York, according to Ballotpedia.
He has served with the St. Catherine's Health and Wellness Advisory Board, the Suffolk County Water Authority, the Community Association of Greater St. James, and the Smithtown Advisory Board.

For the 2025 to 2026 session, he is ranking member of the Senate Energy and Telecommunications Committee and the Corporations, Authorities and Commissions Committee, and also sits on the Civil Service and Pensions, Transportation, and Labor committees.
